subject: NetworkPkg/UefiPxeBcDxe: Add missing Token.Context initialization
reasons: Only 2 lines added in a single file to initialize Token.Context = Private in two write-file functions
While the same field assignment is added in two places (Mtftp4 and Mtftp6 paths), the scope is too narrow (2 additions in 1 file) to justify a Coccinelle rule

A Coccinelle rule matching 'Token.PacketNeeded = NULL' followed by missing 'Token.Context = Private' could theoretically work, but there is no indication of a broader codebase-wide pattern requiring this fix
Bug fix at specific call sites, not a collateral evolution pattern
